note: Parser fixes: cfg(test)-only routes are no longer rejected by the Schema-backed extractor check (cargo test now passes where cargo build does); a renamed local import (use crate::models::Envelope as ApiResponse) is no longer expanded through an unrelated alias of the same name; a plain newtype Path<Ids> with several segments is typed from its field instead of documenting every segment as a string; a garde pattern with a nested class, a set operation (&&, --, ~~) or a leading ] inside a class is skipped instead of documented with an ECMA-262 meaning that differs; a recursive generic instance component whose name collides with a user schema is a compile error instead of being silently dropped.
